name: flowtrack
description: Full-stack project management (Kanban, sprints, roles, notifications)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:client: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
